title: Staging of gastric cancers by PET-FAPI
official: "Contribution of 68Ga-FAPI-46 PET-CT in the initial staging of gastric cancers eligible for curative treatment" "FAPGASTRO"
summary: Main objective: In the study target population (stage ≥ II gastric adenocarcinomas or signet-ring cells adenocarcinomas of any stage, eligible for curative treatment), estimate the proportion of patients who present an appropriate change of TNM classification following the addition of 68Ga-FAPI-46 PET-CT to the reference examinations, during the initial staging (including laparoscopy)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Gastric cancer: stage ≥ II gastric adenocarcinoma or signet-ring cell adenocarcinoma whatever the stage, potentially requiring curative treatment
2. Age > 18 years old at time of signed consent
3. Beneficiary of social security insurance
4. Signed informed consent by the participant and the investigator
Exclusion criteria:
1. Tumor M+ or with suspicion of distant metastasis on standard assessment
2. Person deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
3. Neoadjuvant treatment already started
4. History of other active cancer
5. Known contraindication to a PET examination with injection of radiopharmaceuticals (hypersensitivity to the radiopharmaceutical drug and/or excipients)
6. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
7. Woman of childbearing capacity and not benefiting from effective contraception (HAS criterion)
8. Person subject to a legal protection measure or unable to personally give consent
9. Person in an emergency situation
10. Exclusion period from another protocol
